search_window.basis: since the prior completed hourly check; final observation time from America/Los_Angeles clock

coverage_notes: Supplementary high-value recall only; nationwide production Food Line collector remains authoritative.

12 targeted web searches across (1) only/last/full-service grocery loss; (2) disaster cancellation of emergency distribution; (3) abrupt pantry/food-bank closure or major service reduction; (4) official SNAP/WIC or food-assistance interruption.

No newly published, verifiable, in-window U.S. food-access disruption matching the four classes was identified. Search results were mostly older, out-of-scope, unrelated, or program background; excluded rather than treated as new signals.
All targeted searches returned results without tool failure. Search indexes may lag freshly published local notices, so zero findings is not proof no disruptions occurred.
No approval, publication, primary collector changes, schedule changes, or task disabling.
